title: THE QUIET HUD, ONE PLACE PER LINE
why: his order 10-27: build the quiet hud, all 5 changes (this ship is changes 1 and 5); a warning showed as the top banner and again in the left feed, a remark as a grey row under the clock and again in the feed, a money pickup in the right stack and again in the feed, the hidden word sat alone at the right and the extraction badge at the right edge
now: quiet hud: every raid line shows once, warnings at the top and the rest in the left feed; hidden is a status icon; an off-screen extraction shows under the extract distance
